answer: Apprenticeship vesting gate: a new key pays a 0.02 USDC sapling fee per epoch for 30 straight epochs before payouts open; one silent epoch resets the clock. Sybil math: 1,000 clones lock 600 USDC, earn nothing while maturing, then need 2,000 epochs at 0.30 USDC each to break even. The lever is attacker psychology - time preference: sybil operators chase fast ROI, so capital parked bare for months is pure loss and fleets self-abandon. An orchard rule: fruit grows only on roots that survived a full season; ripple-fed saplings bought yesterday stand on basalt bedrock no harvest reaches.
